text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, April 22 - Chittagong - Port working normally. 27 Vessels in port of which 4 containers, 6 general cargo, 4 food grain, 2 tankers, 1 car carrier, 2 fertiliser, 3 cement, 1 cement clinker, 4 other vessels. 22 Vessels due by 29/4 of which 13 containers, 4 general cargo, 1 food grain, 1 tanker, 1 car carrier, 1 fertiliser, 1 survey vessel. No berthing delays.

INDIA, April 22 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers, general cargo 1-2 days, bulk 4-5 days. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 20 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 7 waiting to discharge, 1 bunkering, 3 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 27 Vessels due (3 coking coal, 10 product tankers, 5 containers, 2 general, 2 crude, 3 coal, 1 timber, 1 steel plates). 7 Vessels loading at berth, 19 discharging, 2 bunkering. Cochin - 10 Vessels due, up to 1 days delay expected. 2 Loading at berth, 5 discharging, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 tanker, 1 general cargo vessel under repair at CSL jetty.

Madras - 35 Vessels due, (5 coal, 3 iron ore, 3 fertiliser, 10 general, 2 edible oil, 2 chemical, 10 containers. Delays expected, coal/coke, fertiliser, others 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days. No delays for containers and iron ore. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 7 to discharge. Mormugao - 15 Vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 4 loading at anchorage, 19 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge. 3 Vessels under repair/dry-dock, 1 awaiting orders.

Kandla - 16 Vessels due, 6-7 days delay expected. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 4 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 5 Vessels arrested in harbour, 3 tankers, 11 vessels waiting. Mangalore - Six vessels due, 4-5 days delay expected. 6 Vessels loading/discharging at berth, 1 awaiting berth, 1 arrested. Jawaharlal Nehru - One food grain vessel due, 10-12 days berthing delay expected, 2 tankers due, 10-12 days berthing delay expected. 3 Vessels discharging at berth (fertiliser, raw material, food grain), 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge.

Paradip - Two vessels due (chemical/gas), 2 vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging, 2 waiting at anchorage to load. Tuticorin - Nine vessels due, 2-3 days delay. 4 Loading at berth, 7 discharging, 1 discharging at anchorage, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 1 vessel under repair/dry-dock. Visakhapatnam - 16 Vessels due, 7-8 days delay expected. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour berth, 2 to load at inner harbour berth, no vessels bunkering.

MALAYSIA, April 23 - Port Keelang - North/south port - Container/ro-ro berth - 6 Vessels alongside, 3 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Vessels alongside, 2 berthed, 2 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Dry/bulk cement terminal - 4 Vessels algside, 2 waiting, 3 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 1 waiting, No waiting time. West port - Container/ro-ro berth - 2 Vessels alongside, no waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 4 Alongside, 2 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Bulk cement terminal - 2 Alongside, 1 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 1 Alongside, No waiting time.

PAKISTAN, April 21 - Karachi - Three rice vessels loading at berth, 1 container vessel loading/discharging at berth, 8 discharging at berth (general cargo, dap, urea, phosphate, palm oil, crude oil). 4 Waiting at anchorage to load (chrome, rice). 6 To discharge (containers, fuel oil, gasoil). 5 Vessels awaiting orders, 8 due with up to 24 hours delay expected for containers/general cargo, 1 day tankers, 7 days rice loaders. Port Qas - Three discharging at berth (jute, wheat, fuel oil). 3 Waiting at anchorage to discharge (seeds, fuel oil, sun oil).

SIERRA LEONE, April 21 - Freetown - No labour problems. Four vessels (1 steel, 1 bulk clinker, 2 aid cargo) discharging at berth, 1 (scrap metal) loading at berth. No vessels anchored, 4 due of which 1 aid cargo discharger, 3 container dischargers. No delays.

SINGAPORE, April 22 - Singapore - Tanjong pagar container terminal - 9 Container vessels berthed. - Keppel terminal - 14 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 4 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 7 General cargo berthed. Jurong - 1 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessel berthed. Oil terminals/sbm buoys - 25 Tankers berthed. Minimal delays at all terminals/ports/buoys.

SOUTH KOREA, April 22 - Inchon - 69 Vessels in port (46 berthed, 23 anchored) of which berthed 8 general cargo, 6 logs, 5 steel, 5 containers, 3 corn, 3 coils, 2 steel plates, 2 pig iron, 2 ply-wood, 1 machinery, 1 silica sand, 1 wheat blending pellets, 1 tapioca, 1 steel bars, 1 wheat, 1 raw sugar, 1 pulp, 1 ply, 1 scrap. Vessels anchored, 4 general cargo, 3 cars, 2 corn, 2 copra, 2 containers, 1 soybeans, 1 logs, 1 tapioca, 1 scrap, 1 palm oil, 1 wheat, 1 coils, 1 ilmenite sand, 1 raw sugar, 1 h-beam. 1-2 Days berthing delay expected.

Busan - 164 Vessels in port (49 berthed, 115 anchored including 57 laid-up) of which berthed, 34 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 58 Awaiting berths with approx. 2 days delay expected. Pohang - 25 Vessels in port (22 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging, 5 billets, 3 scrap, 2 pipes, 1 coal, 1 coke, 1 coils, 1 pig-iron, 1 hot briquette iron, 7 steel vessels loading. 3 Vessels awaiting berths with approx. 1-2 days delay expected.

Ulsan - 28 Vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 3 feed meal, 3 zinc concentrate, 2 wood-chips, 2 fertiliser, 1 ammonia, 1 cement, 1 ethyl benzene, 1 mono ethyl glycol, 1 rocks, 1 wheat, 1 chemicals, 1 propane. Vessels loading, 3 general cargo, 1 asphalt, 1 fertiliser, 1 steel pipes, 1 cokosol, 1 toluene, 1 naphtha, 1 diesel oil, no berthing delays expected. Masan - 15 Vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging, 4 scrap, 2 logs, 1 tapioca, 1 pulp, 1 crane, 1 containers, 1 banana. Vessels loading, 2 pipes, 1 cigarettes, 1 other. No berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, April 22 - Colombo - No labour problems. 14 Vessels loading at berth (11 containers, 3 essential services). 24 discharging (1 bagged fertiliser, 11 containers, 1 bagged cement, 1 bulk clinker, 1 bulk cement, 1 general cargo, 1 bagged flour, 2 essential services, 1 bagged sugar, 1 or/or, 1 LPG, 1 bagged lentils). 2 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (1 containers, 1 essential services). 20 Waiting to discharge (13 containers, 1 flour, 5 sugar, 1 general cargo) 1 bunkering, 3 dry-docked. 6 awaiting orders, 5 container vessels due. Delays conventional vessels 4-5 days, containers 1-2 days. Galle - No vessels operating. Trincomalee - One discharging at berth, 1 loading.

TAIWAN, April 21 - Keelung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 6 days, steel/iron ore 4 days. No delays for grain. Kaohsiung - Five vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 1 day, iron/coal 2 days (CSC berth), coal/scrap 3 days (public berth), steel 2 days. Taichung - Eight vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 4-5 days, iron ore/coal/scrap/steel/others 1-2 days.
